english.title: Sell live / dead Schedule 5 wild animal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) sold

(A)_[a live wild animal]_
(B)_[a dead wild animal]_
(C)_[live wild animals]_
(D)_[dead wild animals]_
(E)_[part or parts of or anything derived from a wild animal]_
(F)_[parts of or anything derived from wild animals]_

included in Schedule 5 to the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 9(5)(a) and 21(1) of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
sell a live/dead Schedule 5 wild animal(s) or
part/parts/anything derive from Schedule 5 wild animal(s)

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Section 10 for exceptions.
(ii) See Section 11(5) for presumption that animal is wild
(iii) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(iv) Section 21(5) provides that where more than one animal is involved in a single offence the maximum fine shall be determined as if the person convicted had been convicted of a separate offence in respect of each animal.
(v) See also associated offence wordings as follows: H4648, H4649 and H4650.

other.penalty:
Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex - see legislation
